deck.shape.kind.note: a shape kind is the outline geometry it is drawn with (E4 mask outlines); a line kind is the E1 line

deck.chart.chartType.note: chart types are forms of the one E3 term chart (a chart-form facet is not in V0)

deck.chart.form.note: chart forms are forms of the one E3 term chart

deck.text.case.note: every case value (none = as typed) is the one E4 facet case

layout.box.role.note: a box role that holds a whole block (list, kpis, quote) maps to the E3 block; `shape` is a drawn primitive whose role the layout gives by its id (card background, marker)

content.chart.chartType.note: chart types are forms of the one E3 term chart (a chart-form facet is not in V0)

content.process.shape.note: process shapes are forms of the one E3 term process (a diagram-form facet is not in V0)

content.cell.type.note: number = the stat / kpi / big-number / number term (one thing in four places, §1.1); a check / rating cell is drawn as icons

brand.decor.type.note: a decor element type names what the element is (E2) or, for pattern / texture / textGradient, the paint it is (E4)

brand.placement.note: the nine anchors are zones of the slide; under-title places a thing in the header stack; full-bleed is the bleed treatment

brand.blend.note: every blend mode (normal included: the identification test is blend != normal) is the one E4 facet blend

brand.cardBlock.type.note: a card's title is the heading of its item and its body the description (E2 tests); a card's logo is a client / partner mark; meta and footer lines are labels

excludedValues.other: names no kind: the recipe is described by its blocks

brand.imagery.sample.kind.note: a sample kind names what the picture shows; as an element it is a picture (photos and UI shots), an illustration, background art, a logo or an icon

brand.template.slot.type.note: custom names no kind: unknown until the slot is identified

excludedValues.none: the absence of a divider names no thing

brand.steps.marker.note: every steps marker style is the E2 marker (its glyph is a style of it)

brand.gradient.use.note: where a gradient is used: on text it is a colour run; as a glow it is decor; on a border a frame; as an overlay a blend

template.element.role.note: the element role IS the E2 term (the enum is the vocabulary)

template.category.note: the category IS the E3 slide kind; unknown = no kind rule held (the vocabulary unknown)

template.element.treatment.note: an element treatment, an image treatment and a mask are E4 terms

excludedValues.size: a measured size ratio (title : body >= 3.5), not a thing on the slide

template.emphasis.carrier.note: what carries a template emphasis: a run (E4), a panel holding text (E2), a big number (E2)

template.mark.part.note: the catalogue header part classes, as maps.catalogue.header

brand.components.note: the `components` object's keys name components; a component that styles a whole block (quote, steps, timeline, logoWall, team, kpi) maps to its E3 block

catalogue.note: The architect's map (V0 task): the catalogue marks (data-type, data-f, header classes) -> the term the vocabulary must identify. `none` = no block (the title container). A list accepts any of its terms (roadmap: timeline with year / period labels, process with step / phase labels; corrected by the coordinator 2026-11-04, as is point -> label).

anatomy.note: anatomy.py's role names before V0 -> the term that replaces each; a role split by a sharper test lists every term it splits into (`terms`).
